column1: # The requests the engine's connect::request writes (the proxy record's unit S2), byte for byte: connect.rs's unit test
# writes each target's request and compares it with its row, and the proxy lab's own check (scripts/proxylab/check.py)
# sends tinyproxy the rows it names, so that a real proxy reads the engine's own bytes. Columns: the target, an address
# and its port (an IPv6 address in brackets) or a name and its port; the request, with \r and \n written so.
